{{Term/Store|Blue-Maned Lynel|Blue-Maned Lynels|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Boss]]es and [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}}<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/><ref name="TotK Hyrule Compendium"/><ref name="AoC Game Screen"/><ref name="AoI Game Screen"/>

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Blue-Maned Lynel}}
Blue-Maned Lynels are a stronger variation of regular [[Lynel]]s that have inhabited [[Hyrule]] since ancient times. They carry the "Mighty" set of [[Lynel Gear]], which includes the [[Mighty Lynel Sword]], [[Mighty Lynel Shield]], [[Mighty Lynel Bow]], [[Mighty Lynel Spear]], and [[Mighty Lynel Crusher]].<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> In [[Master Mode]], they carry the regular Lynel Gear set. Though facing them is dangerous, it is recommended to be prepared if one must fight them.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> 

Like other Lynels, Blue-Maned Lynels will often refrain from attacking for a short period of time after spotting Link, instead opting to stare down its opponent. Though they commonly wield [[Shock Arrow]]s, certain Blue-Maned Lynels may carry [[Ice Arrow]]s or [[Fire Arrow]]s.

Though most Lynels will [[Enemy Progression|Progress]] past Blue-Maned Lynels as the [[World Level]] increases, the Blue-Maned Lynel in the [[First Gatehouse]] of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] will always remain as such.

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Stub|AoC}}
Blue-Maned Lynels reappear in {{AoC}} as [[Powerful Foe]]s, first appearing in the "[[Akkala Tower (Scenario)|Akkala Tower]]" [[Scenario]]. More can be encountered later on during various [[Challenge]]s.

They may drop [[Lynel Guts]], [[Lynel Hoof|Hooves]], or [[Lynel Horn|Horns]]. For each Blue-Maned Lynel slain, the [[Warrior]]s will be awarded a [[Lynel Trophy]] and a [[Wooden Chest]] containing a [[Weapon]].
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{AoI|-}}===
{{Stub|AoI}}
Blue-Maned Lynels are [[Powerful Enemy|Powerful Enemies]] in {{AoI}}.
